mapper.select: /* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSession */ SELECT SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , SITE_CD AS siteCd , TITLE AS title , STATUS_CD AS statusCd , ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd , MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM FROM TB_TBM_SESSION WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectAvailableSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.STATUS_CD = 'OPENED' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.OPENED_AT DESC, S.SESSION_CD DESC

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectInProgressSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.STATUS_CD = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND AT.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SESSION_CD DESC

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectCompletedSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(S.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', S.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, AT.EXIT_AT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND AT.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (S.STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' OR AT.EXIT_AT IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, AT.EXIT_AT) DESC, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD DESC

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionAttendees */ SELECT CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(AT.ENTRY_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD ) WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND AT.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY AT.ENTRY_AT, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SC.SESSION_CD AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SR.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SR.SESSION_CD AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppTbm01Mapper.selectMyCompletion */ SELECT S.TITLE AS title , S.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , AT.EXIT_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD AS mySignFileMgmtCd , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, AT.EXIT_AT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt
, F.FILE_PATH AS signFilePath , F.FILE_EXT AS signFileExt FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON ( F.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = AT.EXIT_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND AT.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND AT.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND AT.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
